about_the_game:
At the footsteps of the King's castle is his most loved winter town. You are one of the last line of defense - the Knight watch.
By day, you build walls, traps, place towers.
By night, you fight endless waves of monsters - undead, zombies, werewolves, wraiths, witches and other creatures of the dark.

In KnightWatch, every sunrise is earned through blood and grit. Build smart, fight hard, and adapt with each passing night in this first-person tower defense roguelike.

Build by Day

Construct defenses, walls, traps, towers and upgrade those buildings. Every decision matters; what you build in the day determines if you'll survive the night.

Defend by Night

Gear up and pick up your favorite weapon to fight off monsters of the night. Defend not just the town but also the towers you built during the day.

Features

  • A unique blend of FPS combat, tower defense, and roguelike progression.

  • Day–night gameplay loop: build, defend.

  • Multiple enemy types: zombies, werewolves, wraiths, and more.

  • Multiple weapons: swords, hammers, and crossbows.

  • Procedural waves and random upgrades for replayability

  • Atmospheric PS2-inspired Pixel 3D art art style

content_descriptors.notes: The game has violence and fighting against fantasy and fictional monsters using weapons like swords, bow and arrow.
